page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 64 GB of DDR memory. Driven by a 2.55 GHz AMD EPYC 7T83 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-virtualized server offers a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio tailored for CPU-bound applications. Dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute throughput without thread contention, complemented by 8 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-core CPU performance and memory scores, alongside average multi-core processing speeds, Redis key-value operations, and compressed file processing. The processor supports advanced instruction set extensions including standard AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and BMI2, though AVX-512 extensions are absent. The server lacks dedicated GPU hardware acceleration and includes no local SSD storage, necessitating the attachment of external block storage for persistent data requirements.

With its 2 GB per vCPU allocation and solid execution speeds, the instance achieves efficient resource utilization for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large RAM footprints or fast ephemeral storage. It provides a balanced operational profile for compilation workloads, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, static web serving, and application server hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized cloud instance powered by a 2.55 GHz AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. Configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 64 GB of System RAM, it provides a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio designed for compute-bound tasks. The instance operates on a x86_64 architecture under KVM hypervisor virtualization and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. Hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI are supported alongside standard AVX vector extensions. Benchmark results highlight strong single-core CPU performance and high PassMark memory scores, while multi-core workloads and memory bandwidth perform in the average range. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or attached local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. This hardware profile provides efficient resource density for web serving, software compilation, CI/CD pipelines, and application workloads.
